title: sdkmessage
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

autotransact.description: Information about whether the SDK message is automatically transacted.

availability.description: Identifies where a method will be exposed.

categoryname.description: If this is a categorized method, this is the name, otherwise None.

createdon.description: Date and time when the SDK message was created.

customizationlevel.description: Customization level of the SDK message.

executeprivilegename.description: Name of the privilege that allows execution of the SDK message

expand.description: Indicates whether the SDK message should have its requests expanded per primary entity defined in its filters.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the component is introduced.

isactive.description: Information about whether the SDK message is active.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

isprivate.description: Indicates whether the SDK message is private.

isreadonly.description: Identifies whether an SDK message will be ReadOnly or Read Write.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the SDK message was last modified.

sdkmessageid.description: Unique identifier of the SDK message entity.

sdkmessageidunique.description: Unique identifier of the SDK message.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

template.description: Indicates whether the SDK message is a template.

versionnumber.description: Number that identifies a specific revision of the SDK message.

workflowsdkstepenabled.description: Whether or not the SDK message can be called from a workflow.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the SDK message.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the sdkmessage.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the SDK message.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the sdkmessage.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization with which the SDK message is associated.
